Single-sequence probe classification: Same probe framework and effective wrapper settings are shared by NT, Genomic Benchmark, and URE sequence-classification tasks.
Zero-shot paired-sequence variant evalua: The shared evaluator routes Mistral-DNA and GENERator to their native paired-variant scorers and GPN-Star to its coordinate-aware native-MSA scorer. Other compatible models use the configured standard LLR path. Mistral-DNA reports an effect distance. GENERator stores REF-minus-ALT log probabilities; use that score directly for disruption ranking and its absolute value for MPRA. GPN-MSA uses its coordinate-aware native MSA evaluator. The adaptive allele-preference tasks retain their separate protocol.
DeepSEA multi-label LoRA evaluation: S21 retains run-level task metrics and protocol/source provenance; runtime outputs are external to the public release.
Adaptive allele-preference evaluation: S38 summarizes the prespecified 30-locus allele-preference analysis; directional agreement does not establish fitness or selection coefficients
Adaptive allele-preference locus-score e: S39 is direct paired scoring; no population-centroid distance or adaptive-population ranking is computed
Ancestry embedding analysis: The GPN-MSA finalizer calls the tracked hEvo_benchmark/scripts/population_classify/Regression_with_admixture.py with --min-shots 10, --max-shots 60, --num-repeats 10, --seed-start 10 and --alpha 1. The script samples training individuals within each superpopulation, fits StandardScaler and Ridge on those samples, and evaluates the remaining individuals. S35 reports shot-level mean and standard deviation summaries rather than individual run records.
